why:
phase-456 W5 — an UPSTREAM name on an ours-only type, which is why it needs a row of its own rather than inheriting `cpp:PollService`'s. `rclcpp::ServiceBase::get_service_name` keeps its comparison on the dispatch half, `rclcpp::Service<S>::get_service_name`, where our class IS `rclcpp::Service` and the two are the same (which is why phase-444 deleted that row when the capability shipped). This is the second copy of it, on the half the split gave the caller.

BOTH HALVES ANSWER, and each keeps its OWN `service_name_`. That is not duplication that could be factored out: the copy is made at create from the argument the caller passed, the runtime takes the name and drops it, and there is no FFI that reads a name back out of either an `RmwServiceServer` or an arena entry. A shared copy would have to live somewhere neither half owns. Same shape as `cpp:PollSubscription::get_publisher_count` after W2b, which reads the `topic_name_` each subscription half keeps.
